notes.title: 【1.0 Release】Theseus Protocol is now in version 1.0.
notes.content:
[h3]After a period of polishing and optimization,  Theseus Accord officially launched its official version on August 22nd. We would like to thank all the players who have been with us since EA. [/h3]

[h3]The 1.0 version can now be experienced in full:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]3 characters with different fighting styles.
[*]9 weapons with different characteristics and over 80 weapon chips.
[*]4 major levels, each with 40 randomly generated mini-levels and 22 random events to learn about the story as you progress through the levels.
[*]66 enemies with different forms and skills
[*]collectable total of 287 cards, 137 pieces of equipment, 26 items.
[*]3 game modes:
    Normal: simple monster behavior.
    Difficult: with some challenge.
    Deep Dive: customizable game content via components, includes 7 built-in difficulties (Normal, Hard, 
    Deep Dive-Deep Sea LV1-3, Supercomputer, Superbody). Also you can customize your level with 82 
    deep Dive components!
[/olist]

This new update is as follows:
. Added a new boss recovery mechanic: Normal Mode restores 100% of HP, Hard Mode restores 50%, Deep Dive Mode does not take effect.
. Added Charlotte's exclusive component in Deep Dive Mode: Weapon Master, which allows you to carry all unlocked weapons in battle.
. Added Japanese translation.

notes.title: [Test version 0.8.0509]Major Update: New mode, New mechanism, New experience!
notes.content:
After a period of beta testing, we have received a lot of feedback and suggestions from players. We would like to sincerely thank our players for their continued support! We have decided to release the new version to the official version, and we hope that this version of Theseus Protocol can bring a better experience to you!

[h1]NOTE:[/h1]

This update will clear players' battle archives (game settings, user archives remain). We expect to update after 8:00 AM PST  on the 8th, players should prepare in advance (we recommend playing through or abandoning the file!)

[h1]The overall update content is as follows:[/h1]

[list]
-Difficulty
·New Normal difficulty: Original Easy difficulty has now been changed to Normal difficulty, and the behavior logic of some enemies has been simplified. The intention description is now more accurate and detailed.
·New Hard difficulty: Compared to Normal difficulty, new enemies have been added: Evolution Cult Disciple (male, elite), Community Aerial Rescue Model, and SWAT Robot (Hacked). Enemy health and armor will be increased by 10%, and all enemy behavior patterns or damage values have been adjusted, as well as some scene effects.

-Cards
·162 cards were remade, and 12 new cards were added.
·Added card details viewing function, users can click on a card in the compendium or deck to view more detailed explanation.
·Improvements made to the rhythm of using all cards for a smoother experience.

-Equipment
·All equipment has been redesigned.
·Added rarity labels to equipment drops and adjust the visual display of equipment accordingly.

-Weapon
·Adjustments made to basic weapon abilities and values.
·Removed the weapon chip unlocking and upgrading related functions.
·Weapon unlocking will only be associated with character level. Players will unlock all character weapons when they reach level 4.
·Removed basic small-size and medium-size chips.
·Modifications were made to some of the large chip functions, and several new functionalities were added to the chip.
·The weapon slot unlocking rule was modified: it will be unlocked according to character level.
·Added an "Imbuement" function to weapons. After recharging or using certain cards, players can imbue their weapons, which will gain additional effects or increased ability.
·Added weapon enhancement feature inside the game, which can be selected at resting points.
·Some weapon names were changed:  
Spark Plug -> Burning Star 
Flame Spirit -> Fire God
Fire Protection Fingerstall -> Glowing Wing 
Firelight Chaser -> Flame Sparrow.

-Character
·Nena's Super High-Spirit: When Nena enters Super High-Spirit, gain 8 Pleasure. At the end of the turn, gain 15 Shield and 30 mood value. 
·Nena has a new summon, Trumpy, which has its own unique gameplay mechanics that can be explored during the game.

-New Function
·Added game records and details function.
·Added story and art-works for loading pages before a BOSS fight.
·Armor repair function and weapon enhancement function were added at resting points.

-Optimization:
·DATA tokens for outside game development have been removed due to limitations with outside development. This feature was temporarily disabled, but the original DATA tokens in the archive will be preserved in case relevant feature design can be used in the future.
·Added dialogue for some enemies.
·Adjustments were made to all descriptions in the game to be more accurate and standardized.
 ·Unified rules were set for all in-game values, where all shield gains can now enjoy bonuses. Damage was divided into constant damage, normal damage, and piercing damage, with relevant explanations available in-game tutorial.
·Intentions were modified to more clearly distinguish between melee, AOE, constant damage, normal damage, and piercing damage.
·Store interface display optimization.
· Adjustments made to victory and defeat result panels, which will now display results in terms of points. Character experience will be settled proportionally.
·Adjustments made to some enemy behaviors.
·Some buff values or functionalities were adjusted.
·Settlement timing of card, weapon, and other function was modified to be more intuitive. 
[/list]

[*] Adjust the layout of props and equipment in the battle interface.

[*] Fourth Map
[*] Normal difficulty
[*] Reward system optimization
[*] Rest point feature added and everyone's favorite treasure spot!
[*] Achievement System
[*] Continuous visual updates
[/list]

The next patch update of "Theseus Protocol" will be more frequent. [b]In order to give you a better game experience, we will open the BETA test of the updated version of the game. [h1]Effect Description Optimization:[/h1]

[Short Circuit]
At the start of the turn, draw fewer cards equal to the number of Short Circuit. At the end of the turn, remove all Short Circuit. 

[h1]Cards Optimization:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [Survival of the Fittest] cost →2, charge points →3.
[*] [First Aid Serum] cost →1, charge →1, randomly clear one debuff.
[/list]

[h1]Chip Optimization:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Chip unlock required number of points decreased
[*] Fixed the chip cap unlocking exception,
[*] Fixed an issue where chip cap unlock could not be upgraded.
[*] Fixed an issue where automatic fire from a float gun did not cause damage.
[*] The level to unlock a chip was changed to 11 and the upper limit of the load was changed to54. Initial load upper limit was changed to 14.
[/list]

[h1]Chip Balance adjustment[/h1]

[Balance Modification]
Old: Increase weapon overload damage rate by 25/50/100%
New: Increase weapon overload damage rate by25/35/50%

[Starfire Walker]
Old: Decrease weapon damage by 50%, overload damage rate by 100%. Decrease weapon maximum cooldown and weapon charge by 50%.
New: Weapon damage decreased by 6. Overload damage rate by 50%. Decrease weapon maximum cooldown and weapon charge by 1.

[Pain Strike]
Old: If your target is in full HP, deal damage to it one more time. Increase weapon maximum cooldown by 1.
New: If your target’s HP is higher than 50%, deal additional 50% damage to it. Decrease weapon damage by 6.

[Lethal Strike]
Old: deal additional 50% weapon damage.
New: deal 3/4/5 damage

[Concentration]
Old: deal additional25/35/50% weapon damage
New: deal additional 2/3/4 damage

[Overload Extension]
Old: Increase weapon overload damage rate by 100%
New: Increase weapon overload damage rate by 25/40/100%

notes.content:
[h1]Version update overview.[/h1]

[list]
[*] New feature: The Compendium is accessible, now you can view all cards and equipment from the current version in the main menu.
[*] Weapon chip system reworked: We have adjusted the weapon chips. The load will now increase based on player level. With more reasonable enhancement limits, it will be a new challenge to match weapon chips.
[*] Balance Adjustment: This time we focus on the balance adjustment of existing cards and equipment.
[*] Adjusted Nena's mood system: 5→3 levels of valiance gained under Lose-Control, gain a random symbiotic card every turn under High-Spirited.
[*] Fix the problem that the game cloud archive did not take effect properly and the archive was lost in some cases.
[/list]

[h1]Attention
[/h1]
This update will clear players' battle archives (game settings and user archives are retained), weapon chips will be cleared of reinforcement level and loading when the game is started for the first time after the update, and compensate for the cost of enough reinforcement to the original state.

[h1]Overall Update[/h1]

[list]
[*] players can now view the weapon screen in combat.
[*] updated the logic for reward drops.
[*] Card Choice screen optimized to allow vertical dragging or scroll wheel page turning when there are more cards.
[*] Automatic target locking when players use cards, weapons, or props, except for special operations in specified locations, will not be released on empty space when the target is displaced.
[*] All equipment, cards and props filled with weapon energy can no longer break the cap to overload the weapon.
[*] Cards used directly by Choice no longer enter the pile.
[*] Evasion works on piercing damage.
[*] Cards that are currently played will not be counted when the discard pile is retrieved or counted.
[*] To prevent possible system crashes, the game cannot run in the background.
[*] In-game video content optimization, Win7 and other systems can also play the animation normally.
[*] Game settings are increased for clearer picture quality.	
[/list]
[h1]Art and visual effects[/h1]

[list]
[*] Some special effects and performance optimization.
[*] Card effects border optimization.
[*] Optimize weapon movement and special effects performance.
[*] Adjusted the special effect performance of mind.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Updates[/h1]

[h2]Deck Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Nerfed cards that were drawing too many cards .
[*] Added consumption or use limit restrictions to some powerful cards.
[*] Changed most of the cards recovered from the consumable pile.

notes.title: Theseus Protocol will officially open Beta testing on December 20th!
notes.content:
Theseus Protocol will officially open Beta testing on December 20th!

[h1]Game Screens.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/10c2217a8ad3a29e27484f1bbe237b529d277ada.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/2b5fb678a0d6b3181c6b3bcee11fb72e5afd596b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/8e28dd97c80fe9114935ddb5774437a41bf8474c.png[/img]

[h1]About the game.[/h1]

Theseus Protocol is a deck-building strategy game set in a futuristic cyberpunk world. You will play as "Prometheus" in this treacherous and ever-changing cyber world, wandering through different territories, encountering ruthless enemies, and uncovering the darkest secrets of Mark Town.

As the mysteries hidden beneath Mark City come to light, players will engage in high-octane turn-based battles and unleash an arsenal of extraordinary cards against brutal adversaries. When spending any available action points, tactical thinking will always be the key to victory. Execute an all-out offensive strike, or utilize a few cards to fuel Prometheus’ weapons? Strategically move position in anticipation of an attack, or build up a solid defense? The fate of humanity lies within the ultimate deck and a masterful strategy.

[h1]What you can experience in this Beta Test: [/h1]
[h2]1. A new character, Nena, is now available![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/31852fde927ef7729d9cddc21a8f896c645b7d34.png[/img]

[h3]Character background story.[/h3]

As a gifted and respected repair master (self-appointed), Nena became a paraplegic after an unfortunate repair accident.

Unable to enjoy a normal life, Nena was given the opportunity to change her fate with the help of a little scientific power, a gift from the Extreme Foundation - a central nerve simulation chip called "Sting", and a 3D-built imitation body to give her a new life.

Since then, Nena and Sting live together and become witnesses to the whole protocol ......
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/90e323c8a0b1828132ad65bec9e1ca7830590d32.png[/img]


[h3]Character Play Description.[/h3]

Nena has a new emotion mechanic; Nena's moodiness brings more uncertainty to the battle. Players playing cards will lower her mood, while weapon charges will raise her mood. The cost of a player playing a card goes up when she's in a low mood, and she gains an extra boost when her mood is high. (No spoilers here, you can discover for yourself~)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/32cb215195d6913bc7a1d3222679fd587637f7aa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/b29857bd4efa09e6dae2e52216d61050e86e1134.gif[/img]

A series of cards dedicated to Nena's emotions; they will provide a high gain effect when the character is emotionally unstable but comes with the risk of making emotions even more out of control.
Nena also has two forms to change. In the second form the damage is higher but with more unstable emotions. While she will deal ranged damage to the enemy when she turns back to Nena.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/d2f27ffbd7443271a464dbf297186474352d1da8.jpg[/img]

Once emotions get out of control, some actions will no longer be controllable!

[h2]2. new third map level, new level boss and elite monsters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/00ed3f8a71355a6a395e35c4953db632b5c1036e.png[/img]

Kangaroo boxer with autonomous counterattack, after you launch an attack to give you clunk three punches with swiftness.

Does it hurt? Pain is right! You need to find a way out of this unfair competition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/1a2ae883cf923ab4b82f8f7c352ae57ad4191743.png[/img]

The three Valkyrie sisters are a special tactical squad, specializing in hunting down all those who are on the consortium's death list.

Each squad member takes on a different role, from a high physical attack and high defense fighting master to a long-range high blast sniper, plus the core commander's mobile support. When you encounter them, you must find a way to break them one by one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/472502b75ad08a7dd1fb8272fe166b3274daf8ac.png[/img]

The final boss is not to be messed with, as the head of the green forest, kangaroo is just his pet. His muscles are not just pretend, ready to meet him?

Combined with the plot direction, there will be more enemies to meet you, from the ruins into the uptown, only through the heavy fighting to find the truth of the world.


[h2]3. Rich weapon development system, unlock more weapons to play[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/b22100e3cb2a9232b5de7ce71c27af2fe83302ce.png[/img]

At the end of each battle, the credits gained can enter the weapon development system to upgrade weapons. This is not only the weapon damage value improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42787095/002034b3e5981398b0ce21c6b4a180e0be11c2fc.png[/img]

Yan Ling, a gun that can only attack singularly, can inflict a full attack on all enemies after performing a credit upgrade. When facing multiple enemies, it can output damage more effectively.

More combinations of play, you need to explore on your own, here will not be too much drama ~

[h1]About Theseus Protocol, the problems that may be encountered in the Beta test.[/h1]

1. During the battle, found that the next round cannot be carried out, you can exit the game and re-enter to solve.
If the above operation is still unable to carry out the next round, please tell us in the channel, we will immediately deal with the feedback received.

2. After entering the weapon raising system and returning to the weapon selection page, you find that UI is not displayed. Please don’t worry, you could directly exit the weapon development page and enter again.

3. When encountering elite monsters and bosses, find that the damage is too high, the effect display bug, the value is not correct and other issues, welcome to give us feedback at any time. We will adjust soon after receiving feedback.


[h1]Key Features:[/h1]

[olist]
[*] Dynamic and stimulating turn-based battles with a strategic twist
[*] Nonlinear, fractured narrative to unravel across a roguelike adventure
[*] Progressive deck building through successive runs
[*] Influential card-fueled weaponry
[*] Three playable characters all with unique combat styles and narrative threads
[/olist]

[h1]Discord Channel:[/h1]

https://discord.gg/V8WJYbFBS6
Feel free to give your suggestions and feedback, we will be happy to meet you.

notes.title: Demo Update Notice
Brief Summary of Theseus Protocol Demo
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo and giving the valuable comments. Thank you all! We are currently working on to refine the game. Hope that you would experience a more complete and great game in the next version. To better collect information, we have updated a new version today. Please try the latest demo.

Here's some of the feedback we've received:

1. Lack of tutorials and no idea how the main character's weapons work.
The first level in the current version did lack a tutorial, and we ignored the threshold for new players to get started. Sorry for that! We are preparing a proper tutorial for beginners and a revised difficulty curve for the overall process.

2. Too few random events, too few shops to trigger, mostly combat levels.
We've received a lot of feedback on this, because it's only the first phase of the demo and we haven't added all the random events yet. We'll try to make up for them later. It's up to you to decide whether to choose battles or events when you meet them.

3. Some monsters sound strange, and sometimes there is no sound.
We'll fix the missing sound effects and get rid of the weird sounds later.

4. The font is too small and some text is overwritten.
Through this trial play, we found a lot of things that need to be optimized, such as font, UI, card description and classification, store and so on. Thank you for your valuable comments. At present, we have adjusted the font, and we will try our best to polish other parts.

5. Each level has three cards, but I have no idea what I've just got.
Our expectation is that players will be able to experience different card combinations and weapon charging, and we will refine the level's reward system later.

6. Game resolution can't be adjusted.
Currently we have a 16:9 lock, but we will consider supporting other Windows later.

7. When we encounter shield damage in battle, our damage is shown as 0, but since the other side increases their shield at the beginning of the turn, our damage is not as expected.

Some enemies (such as the boss in the first level) have a mechanic where they shield themselves before the turn starts, which causes the character to receive shield damage that is not as expected. We will fix this logic hole in future versions so that no one will suffer damage for nothing.

8. The enemy's intentions are sometimes questionable. (e.g. SWAT)
This one has been tested and modified internally. We will make the combat more reasonable in subsequent versions.

9. The bleeding mechanism is not reasonable.
We will definitely adjust this later, we are currently trying to balance the various gains and detractions.


Oh, and keep an eye out for the second new character~
